title: A session whose SessionStart claim of its presence lease failed never takes the lease on a tool event
goal: coord_hook.renew_if_due claims the session's presence lease afresh on a tool event when the state holds no token (a SessionStart claim the store refused or could not run, a re-claim after a refused renew), with the same RETRY_SECONDS backoff a timed-out renew gets, so a live session whose start claim failed shows in other sessions' digests again within a minute of its next tool event. Found by the SP-4cc36epy review (S3, BG-jy6yxnq4 "A live session's coord intent drops out of the digest once its 6-hour presence lease lapses").

run:
import importlib.util,json,sys,tempfile,time
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('h','.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py');h=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(h)
h.STATE=tempfile.mkdtemp();calls=[];resp={}
def fake(*a):
    calls.append(a[0]);r=resp.get(a[0],(0,json.dumps({'token':'T1','expires':time.time()+h.LEASE_SECONDS})))
    if r=='kill':raise SystemExit('killed')
    return r
h.coord=fake
h.branch_item=lambda c:None;resp['claim']=(1,'{}')
h.session_start({'cwd':tempfile.gettempdir(),'source':'startup'},'sidA');resp.clear();calls.clear()
h.pre_tool_use({'tool_name':'Bash','tool_input':{'command':'ls'}},'sidA')
print('tool-event calls',calls,'state',h.load('sidA'));sys.exit(0 if 'claim' in calls else 1)
